scope: Freeze E2/M1 checkpoint 1 request, output, error, progress and invalidation contracts; generated schemas and OpenAPI; public-fixture behavior; negative cases; AC/L1/L2/Track 2 mapping; and the exact boundary that can unlock bounded E3 preparation after independent confirmation.

failures: The first GitHub quality/static-checks run failed AC-22 because the opened-event PR body used the label 'Public QA:' instead of the metadata checker's exact non-empty 'Test/fixture result:' field.
A manual re-run failed identically because GitHub re-used the original pull_request event payload rather than the edited current PR body.
The next synchronize run passed PR metadata but git show --check found one extra blank line at EOF in app/experience_asset/api/routes/__init__.py and web/e2e/m1.spec.ts.
recovery: The Draft PR body was corrected to 'Test/fixture result: Public QA 31/31; contract gate PASS' and visibly verified on PR #16.
The evidence-only follow-up commit triggered a new synchronize event so CI evaluated the current corrected PR body.
The two redundant EOF blank lines were removed without changing behavior; the follow-up commit reruns the complete GitHub checks.
unverified: A successful real-model M1 run on current W7900/ROCm/vLLM.
Serving Reference S1 and commit-bound Vertical Slice V1.
E2 promotion, E3 integration and every E3+ milestone.
